jasmin: Draft RN for v1.25.0 is ready: https://redwood.docs/rn/v1.25.0. Need ops checklist + one-line internal blurb.
leo: added one-line impact + rollback verbatim. keep TL;DR to one sentence.
arun: include DB snapshot tag (snap-20260401) and exact rollback commands. last time ambiguity slowed us down.
jasmin: added snippet: ```bash
redwoodctl deploy set-version --service api --version v1.24.1
redwoodctl db restore --tag snap-20260401
```
leo: set canary trigger: p95 > 220ms for 3 intervals -> rollback. also throttle initial traffic to 1% for 5m.
arun: I'll be on-call for the 02:00 UTC window; add my pager and slack. put PM hold note in RN.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @jasmin for 2026-04-10 02:00:00 UTC to cluster-prod-01. Canary 10m (0.5%->5%). Health checks: /health, /metrics/tokens.
ops-bot: Reminder queued: post 'canary started' 2026-04-10 01:50:00 UTC to #eng-releases.
jasmin: draft internal blurb pinned in doc: "Rolling v1.25.0 (perf & infra); no user-facing changes expected. Ops standby 02:00 UTC. Contact @arun if issues."
leo: LGTM. I'll post in #general 30m prior and tag platform leads.
arun: good to go, monitoring plan set.
jasmin: publishing RN and pinning now. If anyone objects in 10m speak up.
